name: Netherlands
filingNote: Calendar tax year. The return is due by the date in the Belastingdienst's letter, often 1 May of the following year; for the 2025 return, if you got that letter, a request made before 1 May 2026 extends the deadline to 1 September 2026.
lotRuleNote: No sale is matched to a purchase: box 3 taxes the value held on 1 January, not the result of a sale.

card.classification: Box 3: crypto counts among your assets at its value on 1 January. A deemed return on that value is taxed, not what a sale makes. When extra work beyond investing often earns you extra income, that income is declared.

taxableEvents.note: Not taxed as a sale: when you invest and speculate on the price, the proceeds of trading are not declared. The value you hold on 1 January counts in box 3.
Swapping is trading: when you invest and speculate on the price, its proceeds are not declared. Only the value held on 1 January counts, at the rate of the exchange you used.
Treated like any other swap: not declared; the value held on 1 January counts.
Not an event in box 3: only the total you hold on 1 January counts.
Moving units between your own wallets changes nothing; the total you hold on 1 January counts.

Not a box 3 event; the value held on 1 January counts there. A gift may carry gift tax, which the recipient declares and usually pays. An inheritance may carry inheritance tax: the heirs file when they inherit more than the exempt amount.

The sources name neither staking nor airdrops. Box 3 counts what you hold on 1 January; under the actual-return option all income from your assets counts in the year. Mining proceeds are declared only when they exceed the costs.

rates.label: Box 3 rate on the deemed return
rates.note: On the deemed return for 2026 (36 % in 2025 and 2024 as well). The deemed percentage for crypto is 6.00 % in 2026 (5.88 % in 2025), applied to the value held on 1 January above the allowance.

allowances: Tax-free capital (heffingsvrij vermogen): EUR 59,357 per person in 2026, EUR 118,714 for fiscal partners; the deemed return is taxed only on the value above it.
No allowance under the actual-return option, as the supreme court (Hoge Raad) decided.
card.holdingRuleText: No holding rule. The Netherlands does not tax your sale: box 3 taxes a deemed return on what you hold on 1 January at 00:00. The value follows the rate of the exchange you used. How long you have held a coin changes nothing.
card.lotRuleText: Not applicable: no sale is matched to a purchase, because the tax rests on the value held on 1 January, not on the result of a sale.
card.losses: No loss exists under the deemed return. Under the actual-return option a negative year is set to EUR 0 and cannot be set against another year; costs are not deductible, except interest paid on a box 3 debt.
reporting: Box 3 of the income tax return has a field 'Cryptobezittingen' (crypto holdings) for the value on 1 January at the rate of the exchange used.
From the 2025 return the form asks whether you also report your actual return; that needs the values on 1 January and 31 December and the year's total purchases and sales.
caveats: Whether to report your actual return: a rise in value counts even without a sale.
The 2027 allowance, which depends on the Tax plan 2027 (Belastingplan 2027), and the 2027 deemed percentage.
The system proposed for 2029 (2028 if feasible) and crypto's place in it.
Extra work beyond investing that often earns extra income.
The rate of your exchange on 1 January.
What your exchange reports to the Belastingdienst from 2026.
card.summary60: Netherlands: selling, swapping, or spending crypto is not taxed. Your crypto's value on 1 January counts in box 3: in 2026 a deemed 6.00 % of assets above EUR 59,357 per person is taxed at 36 %. If what you actually made was lower, you can report that instead. A system taxing what you actually make is proposed for 2029.

pendingChanges.title: Tax plan 2027 (Belastingplan 2027): the box 3 figures for 2027
pendingChanges.summary: As reported on 17 September 2026: the deemed percentage for other assets comes to 6.37 %, and the rate stays 36 % in 2027 (medium confidence).

pendingChanges.title: Actual-return law for box 3 (Wet werkelijk rendement box 3)
pendingChanges.summary: On 3 November 2026 the cabinet sent an amendment (novelle) extending the capital-gains part of the box 3 bill, and proposed a start on 1 January 2029, or 2028 if feasible.

source.title: Brief van de staatssecretaris van Financiën (Kamerstuk 37053, nr. 5)

pendingChanges.title: DAC8: crypto service providers report their customers
pendingChanges.summary: Wet implementatie EU-richtlijn gegevensuitwisseling cryptoactiva: providers keep data on their customers from 1 January 2026 and pass it to the Belastingdienst by 31 January 2027, then each year by 31 January. Nothing changes in how crypto is taxed.
